primary: Graph support and diversity on the same frozen64 Gaussian/noise starts per condition as the primary experiment.
followup_energy: Primary protocol retains its existing operational gate; this supplementary control does not redefine it. A positive main-method claim must also address this stronger baseline.
training_scope: Real processed OMol25 train split with verified original electronic metadata; no evaluated generated parents, reserved outcomes, oracle labels or new bond supervision.
limits: One training seed is a feasibility comparison, not replicated superiority.
Kabsch and symmetry-aware OT/FM have direct prior art; this small randomized rotation search is not claimed a new OT solver.
The geometric collision cost is not a physical energy or proof of validity.
No finite-time Boltzmann or exact finite-solver density claim.
Conditional path coupling invalidates the independent Gaussian velocity-score proxy; this comparison is FM-only.
The target is additionally symmetrized under identical conditioning-label permutations; physical molecular geometries are unchanged. This is a standard matching baseline, not a new method claim.
purpose: Add type-and-charge preserving Hungarian assignment plus Kabsch before claiming a collision-aware increment. Added during primary evaluation after warm-model structural results; no trained-arm outcomes used to set this baseline.
edge_conditioning: Must be constant within a graph; only equal atom and charge labels may be exchanged.
